coupling_contract.construction: fresh common/private inverse-CDF uniforms on each valid per-agent Markov trajectory
coupling_contract.rho_definition: probability that a pair of agents both use the common uniform, equal to alpha squared
coupling_contract.single_agent_marginal: exact registered policy-induced task kernel for every rho and q

surrogate.drift: minimum eigenvalue of the symmetric projected TD drift
surrogate.step_size: normalized_step divided by projected drift operator norm
surrogate.noise: exact stationary trace second moment of the projected TD innovation at theta_star
surrogate.mixing: SLEM of the exact regenerative current-state kernel
surrogate.risk: T-035 exact scalar finite-horizon delayed Markov risk
surrogate.claim: outcome-free necessary design screen, not a sampled-task result or an exact multiplicative-TD oracle

mandatory_gates.S1: both upstream task kernels, regenerative kernels, projected drifts, and exact fixed points are valid
mandatory_gates.S2: all registered rows are finite, stable, and have at least one fully charged update
mandatory_gates.S3: under rho=0 environment binding, q=16 improves risk over q=1 by at least 5 percent in at least 80 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.S4: under rho=1 environment binding, oracle participation value over q=1 is at most 1 percent in every cell
mandatory_gates.S5: under rho=1 message binding, q=1 is optimal in at least 90 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.S6: best-q support contains q=1 and q=16 for each task
mandatory_gates.S7: message-cell oracle versus strongest fixed-q aggregate geometric improvement is at least 5 percent
mandatory_gates.S8: the message-cell oracle strictly improves at least 40 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.S9: no sampled trajectory, seed, confidence interval, pilot, formal run, or GPU job is used
mandatory_gates.S10: a clean rerun is byte-identical and all configuration, runner, task-kernel, rows, and summary hashes are recorded

stop_rule: Any failed mandatory gate forbids EXP-020A preregistration. Thresholds, tasks, policies, rays, and cells cannot be changed after this commit to rescue T-043A.
